previewNote: Preview: the effect runs isolated and doesn't change your devices.

allInstalled.other: {n} effects installed — they're already in All

noSourcesText: A source is a link to a list of effects published online (for example, a catalog of yours or a friend's on GitHub). Its effects show up here to download.

updatesAvailable.one: {n} effect you already have got a new version.
updatesAvailable.other: {n} effects you already have got new versions.

sourcesEmpty: The sources don't have any effects yet.
allOwned: You've downloaded them all — they're in "All".
sourcesExplain: A source is an https link to an index.json file with a list of effects — for example, a GitHub repository of yours or a friend's. Effects run isolated, with no access to the internet or your PC.
deleteFromAppText: Delete "{name}" from Hydraflow? The copy kept by the app is deleted and the effect leaves Discover. To get it back, import the file again.
